title: Add and Search Words: A Crossword Helper's Blanks
summary: A trie of words where a blank square tries every child at once, abandoning branches as they run out.

analogy.scenario: A crossword helper stores words, then answers patterns with blank squares: a blank (.) can be any letter, every other square must match exactly.

mapping.real: Trying every letter for a blank

takeaway.summary: addWord inserts into a trie. search walks the pattern; a "." tries every child, and the search succeeds when some branch ends exactly on a word's end.
takeaway.timeComplexity: O(L) per search without dots; more with dots
whenToUse: Pattern search with wildcards over a word list

scenes.narration: A crossword helper stores words, then answers patterns with blank squares. A blank can be any letter; every other square must match exactly.
scenes.caption: A crossword helper: words, then patterns with blanks

scenes.narration: With a list, every pattern is checked against every word. In a trie, known letters follow one branch, and only a blank fans out.
scenes.caption: Matching a pattern against every word checks them all

scenes.narration: Store bat: b, a, t, with t marked as a word's end.
scenes.caption: addWord("bat"): b, a, t

scenes.narration: Store ball: b and a are shared, then l and l are new.
scenes.caption: addWord("ball"): b and a are shared; l, l are new

scenes.narration: Pattern b, blank, blank, l. After b, the first blank can only be a. The second blank tries both children, t and l. Under t there's no l, a dead end, but under l there is, and it ends ball: true.
scenes.caption: b..l: the blanks try t and l; only bal has an l next

scenes.narration: Pattern ba: the walk reaches a, but no word ends there. Ba is only a prefix: false.
scenes.caption: ba: the walk ends on a, which isn't a word's end

scenes.narration: Pattern blank, a, t: the blank tries every child of the root, here just b, then a and t, and t ends bat: true.
scenes.caption: .at: the blank tries b, then a, t ends bat

scenes.narration: Pattern c, blank, blank: the root has no c, so there's nothing to branch into: false.
scenes.caption: c..: no c under the root, nothing to try

scenes.narration: Words go in a trie. A search follows known letters along one branch and tries every child at a blank, succeeding when any branch ends on a word.
scenes.caption: Letters follow one branch; a blank tries every child
